g.text: Proxy / engine — the truth oracle (no region enumeration, P3/P0′)

g.text: Write index (D1) — metadata-only, fetched per page

g.text: Jigsaw cache (D2/D3) — one piece per page

g.title: index
g.text: · horizon: index complete for positions ≤ idx_F[p]

g.title: cache
g.text: ABSENT = point interval [t, t] — absence is a fact, not an error

g.title: inv
g.text: (the money property): PRESENT ∧ lo ≤ t ≤ hi−1 ∧ CmAt(p,t) ⇒ cache_val[p] = ValueAt(p,t)
: PRESENT ⇒ idx_known[p] ∧ hi ≤ idx_F[p]+1 ∧ lo ≤ hi−1
no commit change to p inside (lo, hi−1] — decommit→recommit zero-fills
invisibly; mitigation candidate: proxy N-mask watchpoint pass

g.title: act_commit
g.text: append (frontier+1, p, on) to commit log
